title: GRADIENTS launches in one week
content: A week from today I'll be premiering the first of three free 15 minute YouTube videos and releasing my next Gumroad feature “GRADIENTS: Color, Form, Illusion.”---Mark your calendar the premieres and have your questions ready for the chats."How to Light a Landscape" premieres on YouTube Friday September 10 at 11am Pacific time / 2:00pm Eastern / 11:30pm Mumbai time."Painting an Alleyway in Gouache" will be Saturday 11am Pacific time / 2:00 Eastern time"How to Paint an Optical Illusion" will be Sunday 11am Pacific time) 2:00 Eastern time---LightboxExpo.comis an online convention that will be a hub for lots of artist presentations and virtual gatherings. If you sign up (it's cheap to join) you get access to a bunch of great artists and presentations.
